mapper.select: WITH BaseTime AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIME < '09:00:00' THEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '15 hours' -- 어제 09:00 ELSE CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '9 hours' -- 오늘 09:00 END as start_time ), DailyStats AS ( SELECT token_id, SUM(trade_amount) as daily_vol, MAX(high_price) as daily_high, -- 오늘 최고가 MIN(low_price) as daily_low -- 오늘 최저가 FROM token_quotes, BaseTime WHERE candle_time >= start_time GROUP BY token_id ), OpenPrice AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, opening_price FROM token_quotes q, BaseTime bt WHERE q.candle_time >= bt.start_time ORDER BY token_id, candle_time ASC ), LatestPrice AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, closing_price FROM token_quotes ORDER BY token_id, candle_time DESC ) SELECT t.token_id, t.token_name, t.ticker_symbol, COALESCE(lp.closing_price, t.issue_price) as marketPrice, -- 현재가(종가) COALESCE(op.opening_price, lp.closing_price, t.issue_price) as openPrice, -- 시가 COALESCE(ds.daily_high, lp.closing_price, t.issue_price) as highPrice, -- 고가 COALESCE(ds.daily_low, lp.closing_price, t.issue_price) as lowPrice, -- 저가 COALESCE(ds.daily_vol, 0) as "dailyTradeVolume" FROM tokens t LEFT JOIN DailyStats ds ON t.token_id = ds.token_id LEFT JOIN OpenPrice op ON t.token_id = op.token_id LEFT JOIN LatestPrice lp ON t.token_id = lp.token_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS null

WITH minute_stats AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, closing_price AS market_price FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = 1 ORDER BY token_id, created_at DESC ), daily_stats AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, trade_volume AS daily_trade_volume FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = 1440 ORDER BY token_id, created_at DESC ) SELECT t.token_id AS token_id, t.token_name AS token_name, t.ticker_symbol AS ticker_symbol, COALESCE(ms.market_price, 0) AS market_price, COALESCE(ds.daily_trade_volume, 0) AS daily_trade_volume FROM tokens t LEFT JOIN minute_stats ms ON t.token_id = ms.token_id LEFT JOIN daily_stats ds ON t.token_id = ds.token_id
(t.token_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%') OR t.ticker_symbol ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%'))
ORDER BY ds.daily_trade_volume DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT order_id, order_side, order_price, order_volume, remaining_token, created_at FROM orders WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND token_id = #{tokenId} AND order_type = 'LIMIT'::order_type_enum AND remaining_token > 0 AND order_state IN ('NEW'::order_state_enum, 'PARTIAL'::order_state_enum) ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT closing_price FROM token_quotes WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT token_id, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM candle_time))::BIGINT AS candleTime, opening_price, high_price , low_price, closing_price, trade_volume FROM token_quotes WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} AND unit = 1 ORDER BY candle_time LIMIT #{limit}
